inputs.shares_source: 52,801,964 common shares outstanding August 3, 2026 (10-Q Q2 2026 cover page)
inputs.fcf_source: Mid-cycle normalized owner cash: four-year average operating cash flow $535M less sustaining mining capital spending ~$105M = ~$430M; base case uses $230M (FY2025 filing OCF $229M) as trough anchor scaled to mid-cycle $230M owner cash / 52.8M shares ≈ $4.35/sh for Lawrence path — not peak 2022 OCF $842M
inputs.production_source: Steelmaking coal production 9.3 million metric tons in 2025 (10-K FY2025 Item 1)
inputs.cash_source: Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash $310.4M at June 30, 2026 (10-Q Q2 2026; sec_companyfacts)
inputs.debt_source: Long-term debt noncurrent $154.6M at June 30, 2026 (10-Q Q2 2026)
inputs.liquidity_source: Available liquidity ~$483.9M including cash, short-term investments, and ABL availability (10-K FY2025 liquidity disclosure)
inputs.normalization_note: FY2025 was a trough year: net income $57M, operating income $46M, operating cash flow $229M on met coal price weakness. Lawrence base owner cash uses trough-to-midcycle normalization ($230M base owner cash), not 2022 peak OCF $842M. Q2 2026 rebound (revenue $504M, net income $87M, diluted EPS $1.65) supports recovery but is not yet four-quarter run-rate.

blockers: Extreme annualized return requires independent validation with a second method and source-backed evidence.

falsifiers: Met coal prices stay below cash cost for four quarters and FY owner cash falls below $150M.
A directly comparable transaction or asset-specific impairment supports a value below the low-case unit mark after like-for-like adjustments.
The next decision milestone fails, remaining capital rises materially, or the stated success probability no longer fits observable progress.
The obligation, financing claim, tax, or realization friction is materially larger than the low-case reserve.
required_refresh_triggers: new filing or material operating update

change_control.rule: A source fact is locked. Every assumption change requires a reason, author, timestamp, and before/after value.

universal_valuation_contract.decision_rule: No security is decision-grade until every material claim is valued exactly once by a valid calculation proof and every material evidence blocker is resolved.
